purpose: Checkout order ID response returned when an authenticated customer proceeds from cart to checkout.
businessRules: orderId is the UUID-backed checkout draft ID, valid only for the returned expiresAt window.
orderNumber is a customer-readable draft number and is not the final placed order number.
cartSignature is server-computed from normalized product IDs and quantities and is used to detect cart changes.
lines and totals are backend-resolved snapshots and must be treated as the checkout quote for the draft window.
